message: `grpe` is not a kapsel built-in and is refused; native tools arrive in v0.5 (REQ-KS-030)
help: did you mean `grep`? use one of the built-ins (:, true, false, cd, export, exit, test, [, pwd, cat, echo, printf, head, tail, wc, ls, mkdir, cp, mv, rm, grep, sed, sort, uniq, cut, tr, tee, date, seq, sleep), or wait for native tools in v0.5 (REQ-KS-030)
notes: every command is compiled to a WASM component and run in a sandbox; programs outside the built-in list need native tools, planned for v0.5 (REQ-KS-030)
